claims.summary: Sequential multi-load data update and address generation unit for LSU
claims.subject: multiLoadDataUpate
claims.explanation: Module takes address, data routing info, and register list to produce updated writeback data, next address, next register list, and completion flags. Assignments show conditional data selection based on internal counters (num, r_count_2) and register list tracking.

claims.summary: Tracks remaining register loads and generates next address and writeback data for multi-load operations
claims.subject: multi-load data update sequencing
claims.explanation: Module uses internal registers r_registerList_16 to track pending loads, r_nextAddress_32 for address progression, and r_k_4/r_j_4 for destination register indices. Outputs o_endFlag_1 when register list is empty, and o_wbackData_64 selects between full 64-bit or half-width data based on num and r_count_2.

claims.subject: o_wbackData_64
claims.summary: Conditional writeback data selection based on load width and data routing
claims.explanation: When num==2'b10 (double load), passes full i_fromDataRoutData_64. When num==2'b01 (single load), selects upper or lower 32 bits based on r_count_2. Otherwise zero. Indicates support for both 32-bit and 64-bit load types.

claims.subject: o_wbackWen_2
claims.summary: Write enable generation based on load count
claims.explanation: When num==2'b01 (single load), enables only lower byte (2'b01). When num==2'b10 (double load), enables both bytes (2'b11). Otherwise disabled. Controls writeback granularity per load type.

claims.subject: o_endFlag_1
claims.summary: Completion flag when all register loads are processed
claims.explanation: Asserts when r_registerList_16 is all zeros, indicating no remaining pending loads in the multi-load sequence.

claims.summary: i_fromDataRoutData_64 and i_fromDataRout_1 provide data and control from data routing stage
claims.subject: data routing interface
claims.explanation: i_fromDataRoutData_64 carries the actual load data (64-bit), while i_fromDataRout_1 likely indicates valid or routing control. Together they form the data input contract from the data routing pipeline stage.
